title: Main agent
scope: Handles every conversation in Assistant mode
saveUncertain: We couldn't confirm the save. Your changes are still on the screen: save again.
discardHint: What you changed since the last save will be lost.

unconfigured.title: The main agent doesn't have a profile yet.
unconfigured.body: Until you set it up, the assistant does what it does today: it sends the forms that have «When to offer it» and doesn't reply to anything else. Start with the profile.

conflict.title: Review changes from someone else
conflict.message: Someone else saved changes to the assistant. Review what is saved before saving again.
conflict.same: What is saved matches your changes.
conflict.merged: We brought in what the other person saved and kept what you changed. Review it before saving.
conflict.adopted: The screen shows what is currently saved.
conflict.saveReason: First review the other person's changes.
conflict.readFailed: We couldn't read what is currently saved.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Assistant name
profile.toneHelp: How it writes when it drafts.
profile.introductionPlaceholder: E.g. I'm the assistant of Your business. I can help you with…
profile.introductionHelp: What it says when someone says hello or asks who it is.
profile.doesPlaceholder: E.g. Answers questions and sends forms.
profile.handoffMessage: Message when handing off to a person
profile.handoffMessagePlaceholder: E.g. I'll put you in touch with someone from the team.
profile.handoffMessageHelp: The person gets it as written: the AI doesn't draft it. The assistant hands off when a case says so, when it doesn't know the answer, when it's asked about a topic it doesn't answer, when a reply goes over the maximum length and when it reaches the daily reply or form offer limit. The conversation is marked «Needs a person», with the reason.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.help: It's the business information, read only. The assistant uses only what is confirmed: questions without an answer and earlier texts not reviewed are not used.
knowledge.empty: You haven't loaded the business information yet. Without it, the replies the AI drafts hand off to a person.

cases.title: Cases
cases.help: With each message or burst, the assistant picks the case that fits, from top to bottom, and does what it says. If it's asked several things, it replies with up to 3 actions, in order.
cases.limit: You can have up to {{count}} own cases.
cases.ownEmpty: There are no own cases yet.
cases.formsHelp: They come from «When to offer it» of each form and are edited in the form. They go prefilled with what the message says.
cases.lastHelp: Whatever doesn't fit any case above lands here. It can't be removed, paused or moved.
cases.fallbackWhen: Whatever doesn't fit any case above.

editor.title: Case {{number}}
editor.whenPlaceholder: E.g. Asks to talk to a person or someone on the team.
editor.whenHelp: Write it as you would explain it to a coworker: the assistant reads it to decide.
editor.whenFixed: It's fixed: this case always exists and goes last.
editor.inputTypeHelp: Any input, text or audio, already transcribed.
editor.formHelp: Only published ones. It goes prefilled with what it recognizes in the message, and the person confirms it.
editor.textPlaceholder: E.g. We're open Monday to Friday from 8 to 5.
editor.instructionsPlaceholder: E.g. Reply briefly with the business information; if you don't have it, say you're passing it to a person and hand off.
editor.instructionsHelp: The AI drafts with this, the profile, the knowledge and the limits. If it doesn't find the answer, it hands off.
editor.question: Question
editor.questionPlaceholder: E.g. Was it a visit or a delivery?
editor.questionHelp: It's the text of the message, above the buttons.
editor.buttons: Buttons and where each one leads
editor.buttonsHelp: Up to 3, as WhatsApp allows. Each button sends a form, replies with an exact text or hands off.
editor.minButtons: At least one button is needed.
editor.maxButtons: Up to 3 buttons, as WhatsApp allows.
editor.handoffReasonPlaceholder: E.g. Asks to talk to a person.
editor.handoffReasonHelp: It shows in the chat and in the chat list. The person gets the profile message.
editor.activeHelp: If you pause it, the assistant skips it.

actionHelp.SendForm: The one you choose, prefilled with what the message says, as today.
actionHelp.ExactText: The business writes it and it goes out as written.
actionHelp.DraftedReply: The AI drafts, only with what is loaded and within the limits.
actionHelp.AskButtons: Up to 3 options, each one with its destination.
actionHelp.Handoff: Marks the conversation and sends the profile message.
actionHelp.NoReply: Sends nothing; the chat shows «No reply from the assistant», with the case it chose.

limits.title: Limits
limits.help: Always, in every drafted reply: only with what is loaded (profile, knowledge and cases); short and in the person's language; without links, phone numbers, prices or commitments that are not loaded; if it doesn't know, it hands off. They are system rules: they can't be turned off.
limits.topicsHelp: If it's asked about one, it hands off.
limits.topicsLimit: You can add up to {{count}} topics.
limits.cannotPromisePlaceholder: E.g. Delivery times, discounts or stock availability.
limits.cannotPromiseHelp: It can tell what is loaded, but not commit to this.
limits.maxReplyLengthHelp: If a drafted reply goes over, it doesn't go out: it hands off.
limits.dailyReplyLimitHelp: Apart from the form offer limit. When reached, it hands off with the reason «It reached the daily reply limit».
limits.dailyOfferLimitHelp: How many times a day it offers a form on its own in a conversation. A clarification («which of these?») and the chosen form count as one; suggestions to the operator in Manual attention don't count. When reached, the form doesn't go out: it hands off with the reason «It reached the daily form offer limit».
limits.allowedActionsHelp: What is turned off doesn't show in the case editor: a business can keep, for example, only exact texts.

test.title: Test the assistant
test.needsChats: Testing the assistant requires permission to read WhatsApp chats.
test.recordsHidden: You do not have permission to see form responses.
test.help: Write what someone would send on WhatsApp: you see what the assistant would do, in order, and why. It uses what is saved and nothing is sent.
test.unsaved: You have unsaved changes: the test uses what is saved.
test.recipientHelp: The forms depend on what that account can fill in.
test.messagesHelp: One message per line: several lines are tested together, as a burst.
test.messageTooLong: Each message can have up to {{count}} characters.
test.preview: How the person would see it
test.unavailable: The test couldn't finish: the assistant is not available.
test.lost: We couldn't check the result of the test.

handoff.dailyReplyLimit: It reached the daily reply limit
handoff.dailyOfferLimit: It reached the daily form offer limit
handoff.limits: The reply didn't pass the limits
handoff.blockedTopic: It was asked about a topic it doesn't answer
handoff.unknown: It didn't find the answer in what is loaded

validation.actionNotAllowed: This action is turned off in Limits.
validation.repeatedButton: There's already a button with this text.
validation.repeatedUntranslated: Untranslated, it goes out as “{{text}}”, like another button.
validation.repeatedTopic: This topic is already on the list.
validation.tooManyTopics: You can add up to {{count}} topics.

availability.notConfigured: The assistant is unavailable: the AI connection needs to be configured.
availability.modelNotQualified: The assistant is unavailable: the model needs to be verified.
availability.notInstalled: The assistant is unavailable: artificial intelligence is not installed.
